title: "Clear history" deletes all messages from contact's history, instead of the ones I sent
body:
<!--
Thanks for reporting issues of Telegram Desktop!

To make it easier for us to help you please enter detailed information below.
--> 
### Steps to reproduce
1. Issue a "clear history" command with "Also clear for contact" flag
2. On the contact's side, all messages get deleted, including the ones that he sent

### Expected behaviour
On my side, history is completely blank. Onthe contact's side, my messages should be deleted from the contact's history.

### Actual behaviour
On the contact's side, all messages get deleted, including the ones written by him
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: That's the intended behavior, see [here](https://telegram.org/blog/unsend-privacy-emoji#unsend-anything) and [here](https://t.me/durov/102)

comments.author: Participant 1
comments.body: Removing the messages I sent is ok. Removing messages someone else sent from his storage me is a security breach and a privacy violation. The policy MUST be reviewed.

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body: @vtdmhd I agree this feature sucks but apparently [most of the users don't agree](https://t.me/durov/103) with us (although that poll doesn't give a meaningful overview of what the average Telegram user thinks about the unsend anything function). And anyway, it's not a tdesktop issue. You should complain with the in-app support or on Twitter

comments.author: Participant 3
comments.body: I'm truly sorry to do this since I agree with it not being a good choice for telegram.

comments.author: Participant 4
